title: File:Kazan 2015 - Joseph Isaac Schooling 100m butterfly.JPG
depicts: Schooling bending over the starting block in lane 2 before the 100 m butterfly final, Kazan World Championships, 8 Aug 2015
note: 4608x3456 original. Face partly hidden by cap and pose; strong silhouette for a pen-line trace.

title: File:Kazan 2015 - Victory Ceremony 100m butterfly M.jpg
depicts: Victory ceremony, 100 m butterfly, Kazan 2015: Laszlo Cseh, Chad le Clos and Schooling (bronze)
note: Schooling is on the right holding his first world-championship medal. Other medallists are identifiable; crop to Schooling if needed.

title: File:Joseph Schooling Kazan 2015.jpg
depicts: Schooling smiling with his Kazan 2015 bronze medal (close crop)
note: A crop of the victory-ceremony photo, already used for the site's portrait. Kept as the ready-made head-and-shoulders version; not an independent photo.

title: File:Natação.jpg
depicts: The Olympic Aquatics Stadium, Rio, during the swimming finals session of 12 Aug 2016
note: Taken 12 Aug 2016 22:26 local time, the finals night on which Schooling won the 100 m butterfly; Commons files it under the women's 800 m freestyle, so it may show that race, not his. Use as 'the pool that night', never as his race.

title: File:Estádio Aquático Olímpico (Interno) 1.jpg
depicts: The empty Olympic Aquatics Stadium pool in Rio, 1 Aug 2016, before the Games
note: Clean, empty-venue shot; better than the crowded finals photo as a base for a quiet, traced 'before the race' spread.
